# SECRET_GENERATION

A controller that mints secret values in the cluster, so none is rendered into a manifest.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `generation`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.generation`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
